protect_consent_blocking.message: Following your decisions and the chosen mode, the extension can stop future requests to recipients. This may break sign-in, payment or checks on the site. A request already started cannot be stopped: “stopped” is shown only when a rule was in place before the request.

protect_consent_bodies.message: Outgoing request bodies of the tab where you type are scanned in memory (up to 64 KiB, for at most 10 seconds) and discarded. The evidence keeps only the recipient, field type, encoding and parameter name.

protect_consent_detectable.message: A site can notice the module through the GPC signal, stopped requests and wrappers of page functions: MutationObserver.observe (with input matching or session-recording detection) and, in some builds, also fetch, XMLHttpRequest, sendBeacon and addEventListener.

protect_consent_gpc.message: If you turn on GPC, the browser adds the Sec-GPC: 1 header to requests, and page scripts can read the navigator.globalPrivacyControl property. A site can notice the signal and is not obliged to honour it.

protect_consent_intro.message: The module adds actions that change how the browser works. Read what changes and choose the features.

protect_consent_limits.message: The module does not find every transfer. Bodies the site compresses or encrypts itself, WebSocket, WebTransport, requests from workers and the page’s service worker, input in multi-line fields and editable blocks, and data sent before it was turned on are not visible. No findings does not mean nothing was sent. This is not a site safety assessment.

protect_consent_never.message: Passwords (including a field where the password is temporarily shown), bank card numbers and codes, one-time codes. In a document (frame) with a payment field, reading of its other fields is suspended; fields outside that frame, such as the e-mail on a checkout page whose card form is in an embedded frame, are read. If a site itself sends a password in a request, Chrome hands the whole request body to the extension: the extension drops fields named like passwords and stores nothing. A password sent outside such a named field cannot be told apart: that body is scanned in memory like any other and is not stored.

protect_consent_no_server.message: The extension still makes no network requests of its own and sends nothing to the developer.

protect_consent_permissions.message: Access to all sites (if not granted yet) and, for blocking and GPC, the request rules permission will be requested. Without them the module does not turn on.

protect_consent_reads.message: Text you type into e-mail, phone and name fields. The extension’s script on the page derives fingerprints from it, and only those, never the text itself, go to the extension’s background part. They stay in memory for at most 15 minutes and are never written to disk. Neither the text nor the fingerprints pass through the page.

The “Who recognizes you” history only if you tick it below: by day, which recipients appeared on which sites, without page addresses or typed data. You can delete all of it in settings; Chrome should delete it when the extension is removed (not verified for this build).

protect_gpc_rule_written.message: The Sec-GPC header rule is written to Chrome. The extension window on a page shows what was added to that page’s requests.

protect_gpc_sent_note.message: Added to the request is Chrome’s record of the outgoing request. The extension does not know whether the server received or honoured it. WebSocket connections open without the header.

protect_gpc_site_exclude.message: Don’t send on this site (exclude the site from the module)

protect_gpc_site_excluded.message: GPC: $SITE$ is excluded from the module

protect_gpc_site_off.message: GPC: the signal is not being sent to $SITE$ now

protect_gpc_site_on.message: GPC: the signal is sent to $SITE$

protect_gpc_suspended.message: The module is suspended: the signal is not being sent now.

protect_gpc_visibility.message: The signal makes your browser more noticeable: few Chrome users send it. The property is set by the extension, and a page can detect that.

protect_hash_note.message: A hash does not hide the value: the same e-mail or phone number gives the same hash on any site, so it can be used to link visits.

protect_island_error.message: Firewall could not show this section. The rest of the extension keeps working; reopen the window.

protect_launcher_desc.message: Optional module: a firewall for form data, the «Who recognizes» history, the GPC signal and data requests. Off until you turn it on here.

protect_leak_class_first_party_before_su.message: Found in a request to the site itself before the form was submitted (for example, autosave or field validation)

protect_leak_class_opaque_after_input.message: Possible transfer: shortly after your input, a request to $RECEIVER$ had content that cannot be checked (compressed or binary)

protect_leak_class_receiver_unknown.message: Found in a request to an address without a registrable domain: $CATEGORY$

protect_leak_class_third_party_at_submit.message: Found in a request to third-party domain $RECEIVER$ when or after the form was submitted

protect_leak_class_third_party_before_su.message: Found in a request to third-party domain $RECEIVER$ before the form was submitted

protect_leak_class_third_party_moment_un.message: Found in a request to third-party domain $RECEIVER$; timing relative to form submission is unknown

protect_leak_count.message: Requests with this value: at least $N$

protect_leak_empty.message: No matches were observed in the accessible area during this period. This does not mean nothing was sent.

protect_leak_previous.message: Records about earlier pages of this tab: $N$

protect_limit_body_opaque.message: The request body is compressed or binary: its content cannot be checked.

protect_limit_body_truncated.message: Only the first 64 KiB of the request body were checked.

protect_limit_body_unavailable.message: Chrome did not pass this request’s body to the extension: only the address was checked.

protect_limit_budget_exceeded.message: The module’s memory limits on this tab were exceeded: some records, fingerprints of typed values or request bodies were dropped or not fully checked. What is shown is a lower bound.

protect_limit_credential_fields.message: Fields named like passwords, codes or payment data in this request were not checked.

protect_limit_entity.message: The party is determined by registrable domain: domains of one company count as different recipients.

protect_limit_name_plaintext.message: The name was found as plain text: the match may be coincidental.

protect_limit_never_read.message: The page has fields the extension never reads (passwords, one-time codes, payment fields).

protect_limit_payment_suspended.message: There is a payment field: in the document that contains it (the page or an embedded frame), reading other fields is suspended; fields outside that document are read.

protect_limit_previous_document.message: The value was entered on a previous page in this tab.

protect_limit_receiver_hosts_form.message: The recipient is the site of the embedded form where you typed the value.

protect_limit_recent_request.message: The request started before the extension received the value.

protect_limit_submit_unknown.message: The page where you typed the value changed without an observed form submission.

protect_limit_unobserved_channels.message: Not checked: WebSocket, WebTransport, requests from workers and the page’s service worker, streamed and some binary bodies, closed Shadow DOM, multi-line fields and editable blocks (contenteditable).

protect_limit_values_reset.message: The extension’s background part restarted: values typed earlier are compared again once the extension’s script on the page reads the fields again.

protect_locale_fallback_note.message: The full Firewall settings are available in Russian and English; English is shown for the selected language.

protect_no_verdict.message: This is not a site safety assessment; a recognized service is not a sign of trust.

protect_org_policy.message: Your organization disabled the module with the ProtectModuleDisabled policy. It cannot be turned on here; you can delete its data.

protect_password_listener.message: A script ($WHO$) listens to input in the password field. Listening is not reading; the extension never reads the password value.

protect_password_note.message: The extension never reads or compares passwords.

protect_permission_denied.message: Chrome did not grant the permissions; the module is not on.

protect_preset_normal.message: Normal: ask; until you decide, requests go out

protect_preset_strict.message: Strict: after the first observed transfer of a typed value, block that recipient on the site right away; the first request has already been sent

protect_purge_confirm_desc.message: History, decisions, excluded sites, the request log, blocking rules and module settings will be deleted. Observation reports are not affected.

protect_reason_blocking_unavailable.message: Blocking rules and the GPC signal are not in effect now: Chrome did not apply the request rules.

protect_reason_outcome_not_observed.message: Part of the module did not start; it will retry at the next extension event.

protect_reason_storage_unavailable.message: The module’s browser storage is unavailable: decisions and history may not be saved.

protect_reload_note.message: Changes apply to pages loaded after the change.

protect_req_basis_ccpa_opt_out.message: CCPA rules for opting out of sale: 15 business days (not confirmed)

protect_req_basis_gdpr_art_12_3.message: GDPR Art. 12(3): one month, extendable to three months

protect_req_basis_pdl_152_art_20.message: 152-FZ Art. 20: 10 working days, extendable by 5 more

protect_req_clear_desc.message: All log entries are deleted from this device. Letters already sent are not cancelled.

protect_req_clipboard_note.message: Copied text goes to the system clipboard and to its history if it is on.

protect_req_copied.message: The text was copied to the clipboard.

protect_req_copy_failed.message: Automatic copying did not work: the text is selected, press Ctrl+C.

protect_req_deadline_note.message: The deadline is counted from the sending date you entered; the law counts it from receipt. Public holidays are not taken into account.

protect_req_delete_desc.message: The entry is deleted from this device. If the letter was already sent, deleting the entry does not cancel it.

protect_req_draft_badge.message: Draft: the template texts have not been reviewed by a lawyer

protect_req_entity_invalid.message: Enter the company name (up to 128 characters).

protect_req_export_desc.message: The file has the log entries: laws, requests, companies, dates and statuses. The extension does not store your identifier, name or letter texts, so they are not in the file.

protect_req_export_facts_warning.message: The file will contain sites you visited and data receivers.

protect_req_facts_hint.message: The company will learn the sites and dates in the ticked rows.

protect_req_gpc_mention.message: Mention the Global Privacy Control signal my browser sends

protect_req_ics.message: Add the deadline to the calendar (.ics)

protect_req_ics_alarm.message: In 3 days: response deadline of a personal data request

protect_req_ics_desc.message: The file has only the deadline date and a reminder 3 days before, no sites or observations. Check the text and save the file.

protect_req_ics_description.message: $LAW$: $KINDS$. The deadline is approximate: it is counted from the sending date you entered, public holidays are not taken into account.

protect_req_ics_summary.message: Response deadline of a personal data request

protect_req_identity_required.message: Type the identifier or choose “By the address I send the letter from”.

protect_req_identity_sender.message: By the address I send the letter from

protect_req_identity_title.message: How the company will find your data

protect_req_identity_typed.message: By another identifier that I type in

protect_req_identity_value_label.message: Identifier (for example, an e-mail address or a phone number)

protect_req_identity_warning.message: The company will receive this identifier. The extension does not save what you type and never fills it in itself.

protect_req_intro.message: The extension drafts the request on this device. You send it yourself, from your e-mail or through the company’s form; the extension sends nothing.

protect_req_journal_storage.message: The log is stored only on this device, in the browser database, without encryption. The extension does not store your identifier, name or letter texts.

protect_req_jurisdiction_hint.message: Choose the law that applies to you. The extension does not infer it.

protect_req_kind_access.message: Confirm the processing and provide a copy of the data

protect_req_kind_objection.message: Object to processing for marketing and profiling

protect_req_kind_opt_out.message: Opt out of the sale and sharing of data

protect_req_mailto_long.message: The letter is long: the mail program gets a short text, and the full text is copied to the clipboard by the same click — paste it into the letter.

protect_req_mailto_note.message: If your mail program is web mail, the letter text is passed to it in the link address.

protect_req_mailto_shortened.message: The full text was copied to the clipboard: paste it into the letter instead of the short one.

protect_req_module_off.message: There is no log: the Protection module is off or its data was deleted.

protect_req_not_legal_advice.message: This is not legal advice. The letter makes a request under a specific article and does not claim that the company broke the law.

protect_req_portal_copied.message: The text was copied: paste it into the company’s form.

protect_req_readonly.message: The Protection module is not running now. You can view, export and delete the log; new letters and status changes are available after you turn the module on in the settings.

protect_req_recipient_invalid.message: Check the address: Latin letters, digits and . _ + - before @, then the domain.

protect_req_recipient_table.message: from the extension’s directory, checked on $DAY$

protect_req_recipient_unknown.message: The directory has no verified address for this company. Find it in its privacy policy and enter it.

protect_req_retention.message: Unsent entries are deleted after 30 days, closed ones after 365 days, any entry 730 days after creation.

protect_req_ru_formal_note.message: Under Federal Law 152-FZ a request needs identity document details and a signature. The extension neither asks for nor stores them.

protect_req_saved.message: The request was added to the log as prepared. When you send the letter, mark it as sent.

protect_req_source_missing.message: The observation is no longer stored (it expired, was deleted or the tab was closed). You can prepare the letter without it.

protect_req_status_extended.message: the company extended the deadline (marked on $DATE$)

protect_section_desc.message: Optional module, off by default. When on, it compares the text you type with outgoing requests (in memory only), can stop future requests according to your decisions, recognizes signs of session recording, keeps an optional local history and sends the GPC signal. Observation works the same with or without it.

protect_since_before_value.message: the request started before the extension received the value (within 10 s)

protect_sites_desc.message: On these sites the module does not read fields, offer recipient decisions or record history; “everywhere” rules and strict-preset rules do not act here. Rules made for the site itself (by you or by strict mode) keep acting until you remove them. The browser adds no GPC signal to requests of these sites and their pages; frames of other sites embedded in them may still get it (not verified). Observation works as usual.

protect_sites_invalid.message: Enter a site name, for example bank.example.

protect_snooze_until.message: Marks hidden until $TIME$; rules keep working

protect_state_needs_consent.message: Suspended: the module’s terms changed, confirm your consent again

protect_state_needs_permission.message: Suspended: access to all sites or the request rules permission is missing

protect_where_body_form.message: Where: form field $NAME$ in the request body

protect_where_opaque.message: The request body cannot be read

replay_basis_behavior.message: The conclusion is based on page behavior, not on the content that was sent

replay_disclaimer.message: This is not a safety assessment of the site. Session recording is used for analytics and support; a recognized service does not imply trust

replay_level_help_none.message: no sign in the covered area; this does not mean there is no recording

replay_level_help_replay_like.message: subscriptions to input and movement, observation of the document and periodic sends to another site (or a resource of a service by an enabled rule); low confidence

replay_level_help_replay_recording.message: the same signs are linked by a stack sample to scripts of the receiving site, or by a service rule to its send address; medium confidence, the content of the recording is not checked

replay_level_help_signals_only.message: isolated signs, but their combination was not observed

replay_level_none.message: No signs of session recording were observed in the covered area during this period

replay_level_signals_only.message: Isolated signs of session recording; not enough for a conclusion

replay_like_note.message: Event autocapture tools (product analytics) behave similarly

replay_limit_body_size.message: Body sizes are visible only in a tab where you type into a tracked field; other sends are counted without a size

replay_limit_cadence_reset.message: The extension's background part restarted: periodic sends are counted again from that point

replay_limit_element_listeners.message: Handlers on individual elements and fields are not counted, only at the window and document level

replay_limit_first_party.message: Sends to the site itself are not assessed: recording through the site's own domain cannot be told apart from its normal work

replay_limit_hosts_truncated.message: There are more receivers than the report holds: those with the longest series are shown

replay_limit_listener_hook_off.message: Event subscriptions are not tracked in this build: the subscription sign is unavailable

replay_limit_loaded_before_enable.message: The page was loaded before the feature was turned on: subscriptions are counted after a reload

replay_limit_mo_hook_off.message: MutationObserver is not tracked in this build: the document observation sign is unavailable

replay_limit_mo_options.message: MutationObserver options are not read: only the call on the document is counted

replay_limit_no_script_attribution.message: Subscriptions are not linked to a specific script, so the conclusion stays at “looks like session recording” at most

replay_limit_uncalibrated.message: Thresholds are not calibrated on real sites

replay_limit_websocket.message: Data sent over WebSocket is not visible

replay_limit_workers.message: Requests from the page's background threads (workers) may not be counted

replay_masking_unconfirmed.message: Input masking: not confirmed. The extension cannot see the recording settings and does not decode the data that was sent

replay_masking_value_seen.message: A value you typed was found in a request to $SITE$ — see “Transfer of data you entered”

replay_receivers_more.message: $N$ more receivers — in the side panel

replay_signal_periodic.message: Periodic sends to $SITE$: up to $RUN$ in a row, 1–15 s apart

replay_signal_periodic_none.message: Periodic sends to another site, 1–15 s apart

replay_signal_root_input_listeners.message: Page-wide subscriptions to keyboard input and to mouse movement or scrolling

replay_signal_root_mutation_observe.message: Observation of changes to the whole document (MutationObserver)

replay_signal_script_site.message: (scripts of $SITE$ — from a stack sample, data from the page context)

replay_signal_vendor_resource.message: A resource matched an enabled rule of a session recording service: $VENDOR$

replay_vendor_rules_disabled.message: Session recording services are not recognized: the rules have not been verified on test pages yet

scope_protect_revoke_warning.message: The Protection module is on: without access to all sites it is suspended until access is granted again.

site_removed.message: Site $HOST$ removed and access revoked. Reload open pages of this site to remove the sensors completely.

site_removed_access_kept.message: Site $HOST$ is no longer observed, but Chrome kept access to it. You can revoke access in Chrome settings.

site_removed_all_sites_kept.message: Site $HOST$ removed from the list. Access to all sites is still granted — you can revoke it in this section.

site_status_required.message: access set by this build, cannot be revoked
